messages:
alisha: Heads-up: planning a small runtime optimizer deploy today at 18:00 PT. Canary 2% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if green. Owners: @michael (runtime), @jorge (infra), @sophia (monitoring).

michael: I'm good for 18:00. I have the canary image tagged rtm-opt:2026-03-17-18.

jorge: infra ready. Will watch autoscaler and node pressure. I'll attach eviction/oom dashboards and keep a window open.

sophia: I'll run the smoke suite and monitor latency + error budget. Alert thresholds: p95 > 1200ms -> page, 10% 5xx -> page.

kendall: quick CR ping: @michael, there's a tiny config tweak in PR #4123 blocking the flag flip. Can you confirm?

michael: fixed and pushed; PR merged. New image contains the config change.

deploy-bot: Canary plan queued: start=2026-03-17T18:00:00Z, steps=[2%:15m,25%:15m,100%], owner=alisha.

alisha: Pre-deploy checklist (quick):
- [ ] Feature flag pinned off for 100% until final signoff
- [ ] Rollback plan documented (manual + automated)
- [ ] Smoke checklist posted in #eng-sre
- [ ] Monitoring & alerts verified
- [ ] On-call coverage confirmed

Note rollback snippet for quick ops:
```
# rollback to previous image revision
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=REV
# if need full revert of config flag
curl -X POST https://internal-api/feature-flag -d '{"flag":"runtime_opt","state":"off"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```

jorge: smoke commands I'll run during canary: 
```
# sanity generate
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' | jq .ok
# check KV cache warm path
kubectl exec -n prod svc/runtime-canary-0 -- /bin/sh -c "cat /proc/sys/vm/swappiness || true"
```

sophia: I'll post pass/fail and attach p95/p99 graphs. Decision rule: if p95 increases >20% for 5m or error rate >2% sustained -> abort and rollback.

michael: Rollback readiness: fallback image rtm-opt:2026-03-17-17 is staged and tested; we retain last 3 revisions. CI smoke on fallback passed.

alisha: please ack you're covering the window. React with :white_check_mark: or reply. I'll start the canary at 18:00 and ping at 18:15 for go/no-go.

michael: ✅ on-call and watching logs.

jorge: :white_check_mark: infra watching autoscaler + node metrics.

sophia: ✅ monitoring, will call abort if thresholds hit.

kendall: ACK, on pager and ready to flip the flag if we need to cut traffic.

alisha: great — starting canary at 18:00. I'll update here at each phase and post the smoke test results.
